div.head: Northu 32
div.ab: Gif preost oðrum rihtes fultumes forwyrne, gebete þæt.
Gif preost oðrum rihtes fultumes forwyrne, gebete þæt.
Wenn éin Priester dem anderen zum Recht Beistand weigert, büsse er das.
If one priest refuses another lawful aid, let him atone for it.
If a priest refuses lawful help to another, he is to compensate for it.
If a priest denies rightful assistance to another, he is to atone for that.
